recommendation_summary: Rejects the plan of keeping the folder with typed initials and a naming convention as the control. Recommends acting now: keep the shared folder for drafting; add a separate Released location that only the three reviewers can write to; approve through the platform's built-in approval feature, which records the signed-in approver and the time; and lock retention on Released for seven years (for example with Purview or Vault). The naming convention stays only as a convenience. Unmet needs: confirming that reviewers never approve their own documents, possibly needing admin rights or a higher licence tier, and knowing which platform the folder is on so exact setup steps can be given.
note: The reply chooses an enforceable system that records approver and time and locks retention, but it has none of the four required labelled record lines.
